title: Extents
message: No machine: readings assumed from the profile defaults, and a word whose reading depends on the machine is not resolved. 2 positions not resolved; the findings say why.

findings.message: 2 subprogram calls, first M98 P3000 (line 8): the called program is not in this document, or gEdit does not follow this call (a repeat, a jump into the program, a macro with arguments, a call inside the called program), so where it leaves the tool is not known; the positions after it are not resolved until a block writes them.
2 incremental words, first Y5. (line 9), move from a position the program does not state (the start, or after a machine position, a cycle, a frame or a value that was not resolved): not resolved.
